Good news — Japanese passport holders can visit Vietnam visa-free for up to 45 days, so your roughly six-week (42-day) trip fits comfortably within that window with no visa needed.

Details:
- Pathway: Visa-free entry (unilateral exemption)
- Max stay: 45 days per entry
- This exemption is currently extended through 2028-03-05
- Passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date

If you ever wanted to stay longer than 45 days, an e-Visa is also available to all nationalities (Japan included) for up to 90 days, costing USD 25 (single-entry) or USD 50 (multiple-entry), applied for at evisa.gov.vn.

Data as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking current policy at https://evisa.gov.vn/ before you travel, just in case anything changes closer to your trip.
